packet.title: Public API: XML parser, processor, XPath, adaptive output (design)

body.p: After . Owns include/sxml/xml.h, processor.h, xpath.h, serialize.h (). xml.h: bytes (encoding detected, source name, limits) into any sxml_tree_builder, errors with line and column (). processor.h: owns pool, registry and heap (); host resolver for fn:doc (); implicit timezone, current dateTime. xpath.h: static context configuration (namespaces, external variables and types, static base URI), compile, evaluate with context item, variables and resolver. serialize.h: adaptive method only. Done when header check, lints and rubric pass and the driver (1.24) and CLI can be written against these alone. Done 2026-10-16 ().
